nodes.label: Company Registry Sync Workflow
nodes.rationale: Nightly (02:17 UTC) incremental refresh of public.company_registry (MCA data via data.gov.in), used for employer-name matching in EPFO/AuthBridge verification. Runs as a CI job rather than an in-process cron inside the web service specifically to avoid competing with live user traffic for CPU/memory, and so a stuck run can't take the API down; bounded by DEFAULT_INCREMENTAL_MAX_PAGES.
